content.description: VyFinance is a Decentralized Finance procotol bringing passive staking strategies to Cardano. Neural Net Yield Aggregation leads the way, with a Hedge Fund coming soon... VyFinance is a DEx & DeFi protocol within the Cardano ecosystem. In addition to building a DEX, VyFinance has been one of the principal software innovators in the Cardano ecosystem. Thus far we have been instrumental in creating first time applications such as governance, a functional lottery design, NFT staking, stakeless LPs, Layer Two LPs, multi-currency token staking and our Bar in which a certain percentage of fees accumulated from our ecosystem are distributed to our VYFI holders.
